value.rationale: The paper proves NP-completeness of arbitrary-value reordering and only 3/2 guarantee for two agents. Exact closed optimum and complete parameter classification for the first nontrivial positive heterogeneous size domain identify precisely when the source greedy algorithm succeeds, extending the isolated sharpness example to all multiplicities; the infinite characterization has nonroutine model-specific content.
